Export viewing key
Viewing keys cannot spend funds.
A viewing key lets a compatible dashboard or accounting tool scan some or all activity for this account.
A full viewing key reveals past and future account activity. Access continues for future activity and cannot be revoked without moving funds to a new wallet account.
